reviewNotes: Reviewed all 135 distinct speech keys against all 20 cards and explicit vocabulary furigana in data/pages51.json. Checked contextual topic は → わ, directional へ → え, object を → お. Preserved lexical はらわた, はなやか, はず, はいけい, はいごう and はたらき, plus conjunction または. Checked しょうじんに, そうだぶし, さばぶし, ぶしけい, おいがつお, きはつせいこうき, ぎょせつこう, きのここう, かいそうしゅう, たとうるい, ちんでんぶつ, びりゅうし and しょかいちゅうしゅつ against source. Retained explicit source 魚系 reading ぎょかいけい. Converted loanwords to hiragana preserving long-vowel marks and punctuation; added terminal punctuation where needed. Display labels and lookup keys unchanged. No listening or pitch-accent verification.
